integrity_notes.per_file_identifier: git_blob_sha1 is the Git blob object ID returned by the pinned Git tree API; it is not a SHA-256 digest.
integrity_notes.sha256: Not returned by the Git tree API and not independently computed because no file contents were downloaded.

scope: Only Git blobs below data/v33da_sample/ at the pinned repository commit; no full-release files.

source_disclosure.metadata_discrepancy: The included metadata.json and split_summary.json report 33,625 full-release rows/counts; they do not provide a verified sample-specific split. Do not use those full-release counts as the sample split.
source_disclosure.path_inventory: Contains 100 microphone WAVs, 100 accelerometer WAVs and 100 MP4 clips. Path-derived event keys match across all three modality sets; this does not verify joins inside the Parquet content.
source_disclosure.rights: The nested sample README declares CC BY 4.0. This is an upstream declaration, not independent per-file rights or commercial-use clearance.
source_disclosure.root_readme: Describes a self-contained 100-event sample, stratified across BP01/BP02/BP05, about 60 MB, including Parquet, WAV, MP4 and camera-calibration files.
source_disclosure.sample_rows: The root README says the sample Parquet has 100 rows. Parquet bytes were not retrieved or inspected.
